prerequisites: Competencies from Algorithms and Data Structures
Competencies from System Software and Computer Communication

learning_outcomes.text: The students can explain the functionality of operating systems.
The students can independently program operating system modules.
The students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently identifying, formulating, and solving problems.
The students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercises, achieving at least 50% of points
Oral presentation of the solution to at least two exercises

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program. Prerequisites for earning credit points include achieving at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercises and an oral presentation of the solution to at least two of the exercises. The examination can be either an individual oral examination or a written exam (Klausur).
bibliography: Tanenbaum, A.; Bos, H. : Modern Operating Systems, Pearson 2015.
Silberschatz A./Galvin P./Gagne G..: Operating System Concepts, Wiley, 2019.
